bosmdavid-gif-dropthehassle-skill-buy-do.description: Finds a free domain name for the user's website and hands them a payment link to buy it, with DropTheHassle. Use when the user wants to buy a domain, find a domain name, check if a .com is available, "get a .com" or "my own domain" for a site. Checks real availability and price with search_domain or the DropTheHassle domain search API, suggests a short list, and after a yes returns a checkout.stripe.com link the human pays. The site goes live on the name with HTTPS and no DNS. The agent never pays.
bosmdavid-gif-dropthehassle-skill-buy-do.author: DropTheHassle

bosmdavid-gif-dropthehassle-skill-custom.description: Connects a domain the user already owns (bought at another registrar) to their DropTheHassle site, free, with one A record. Use when the user says "use my own domain", "connect my domain", "add a custom domain", "point my domain to my site" or already has a .com at GoDaddy, Namecheap, Cloudflare or similar. Gets the A record from DropTheHassle, shows it to the human to set at their registrar, then checks HTTPS is live. Never edits DNS at the registrar for them. For a name they don't own yet, use buy-domain.
bosmdavid-gif-dropthehassle-skill-custom.author: DropTheHassle

bosmdavid-gif-dropthehassle-skill-domain.description: Sets up email on the user's own domain, such as hello@yourdomain.com, a real mailbox that sends and receives, with DropTheHassle. Use when the user wants domain email, a professional email address, an inbox like info@ or hello@ on their domain, or asks "can I get email on my domain". Checks the domain is active with site_status, then hands the human a checkout.stripe.com payment link from get_email_checkout_link (main inbox €5 / $5 a month). The agent never pays and never reads the mail.
bosmdavid-gif-dropthehassle-skill-domain.author: DropTheHassle

bosmdavid-gif-dropthehassle-skill-dropth.description: Publishes (deploys) a built website or web app to a free HTTPS link, then your own .com with no DNS. Use when the user wants to deploy a website, publish a website or host a website, or says "go live", "make it live", "put this live", "put it online", "publish my site", "deploy my website", "host my website", "share it with friends", "send my friends a link", "get a link", "make it public", "it only works on localhost" or "get a .com", or asks to deploy or host a site built with an AI tool (Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, Windsurf, Lovable, Bolt, v0, ChatGPT), or mentions DropTheHassle, and has…
bosmdavid-gif-dropthehassle-skill-dropth.author: DropTheHassle

bosmdavid-gif-dropthehassle-skill-publis.description: Publishes (deploys) a finished website to a free HTTPS link with DropTheHassle, in one command and with no account. Use when the user wants to deploy a website, publish a website, host a website, "go live", "make it live" or "get a link" for a site an AI built, and has not picked another host. Runs `npx -y dropthehassle@latest deploy` on the built folder and returns the live link and a claim link. Own domain (buy domain) and email on my domain come after, as payment links the human pays. The agent never spends money.
bosmdavid-gif-dropthehassle-skill-publis.author: DropTheHassle
